d: SpaceX has made history as its Starship spacecraft returned from orbit and was caught mid-air by giant mechanical “chopstick arms” above Launch Pad 2 at Starbase, Texas. After a 22-hour journey and 14 orbits around Earth, the spacecraft descended through the clouds and manoeuvred between the launch tower’s massive mechanical arms in an unprecedented recovery. The mission also saw Starship deploy 26 Starlink satellites, marking a major milestone in SpaceX’s push towards rocket reusability.
